brief.purpose: Help a county emergency operator inspect a real storm warning, work a sourced call-first facility list, inspect actual Zetaris and Nemotron evidence, record contact and export without losing their place.
brief.audience: Emergency operators who need calm hierarchy, immediately reachable phone actions, explicit source age and trustworthy failure states under pressure.
brief.framework: Next.js 16, React 19, strict TypeScript, Tailwind 4, local-first snapshot. Preserve existing tested ranking, query-ID evidence, CSV/print and mobile keyboard workflow. No public deployment.
brief.anchors: Night Ledger. Carbon paper, brass, black book cloth. Ivory editorial authority, a dominant source atlas, narrow utility rails and one moving brass index. Ambitious graphic composition with restrained operational focus.
brief.taboos: Generic SaaS cards, oversized marketing hero in operator view, decorative metrics, emoji, purple gradients, neon/hologram imagery, fake radar or location routes, invented data, hidden states, unsourced urgency.

direction.name: Night Ledger
direction.composition: Deep margins, narrow measures, and one luminous interruption
